title: Playing as boys for rich families on the lake; father's lessons on money
summary: As a teenager he, Sylvester and cousins played on porches for coins, took the money home, and his father taught them not to be handed money.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
